headline: As of 2026-10-31: 51,286,359 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.1 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 51,286,359 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.1 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,318,988), California (5,094,898), Florida (4,729,111).
